
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/deali/p/19123387" title="发布于 2025-10-02 11:32">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">在Linux系统上一键配置DoH，解决DNS解析被污染</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="前言">前言</h2>
<p>最近我的 swag 服务突然证书 renew 失败</p>
<p>诊断了一下发现原来是无法解析 <code>acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org</code> 域名</p>
<p>换了几个 DNS 都不行，应该是 DNS 被污染或者劫持了</p>
<p>这时我才意识到不上 DoH/DoT 怕是没办法了🤣</p>
<p>本文记录一下用一种简单的方法在服务器上实现 DoH/DoT</p>
<h2 id="dohdot">DoH/DoT</h2>
<p>简单科普一下，DNS 是用来把网站解析到IP地址的协议</p>
<p>正常的 DNS 是明文传输，很容易被污染或者劫持</p>
<p>DoH 是 DNS over HTTPS，走加密的 HTTPS 流量（443 端口），看起来就像访问网页一样，不容易被污染或者劫持</p>
<p>除此之外还有 DoT（DNS over TLS）、ODoH（Oblivious DoH，隐私更强），都是更加安全的域名解析方式</p>
<h2 id="cloudflared">cloudflared</h2>
<p><a href="https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared</a></p>
<p>这是 Cloudflare 官方开源的一个 Cloudflare Tunnel 客户端，用 go 语言开发的，非常容易安装部署。</p>
<h3 id="简介">简介</h3>
<p>这个客户端不仅可以接入 Tunnel 实现内网穿透，还可以实现 DoH 代理</p>
<p>本文使用这个工具来实现 DoH 配置</p>
<h3 id="安装">安装</h3>
<p>Ubuntu Server 的官方软件源没有这个工具</p>
<p>需要添加 Cloudflare 官方 APT 源</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 1. 添加 GPG key
curl -fsSL https://pkg.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-main.gpg | sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/cloudflare-main.gpg &gt; /dev/null

# 2. 添加软件源
echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/cloudflare-main.gpg] https://pkg.cloudflare.com/cloudflared jammy main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/cloudflared.list

# 3. 更新并安装
sudo apt update
sudo apt install cloudflared
</code></pre>
<p>也可以直接下载 DEB 包安装</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 1. 下载 cloudflared 最新 deb 包
wget https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-linux-amd64.deb

# 2. 安装
sudo dpkg -i cloudflared-linux-amd64.deb

# 3. 验证
cloudflared --version
</code></pre>
<h3 id="测试">测试</h3>
<p>安装好以后，运行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo cloudflared proxy-dns --address 127.0.0.1 --port 5053
</code></pre>
<p>测试一下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">dig @127.0.0.1 -p 5053 acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org
</code></pre>
<p>如果能返回解析结果，就说明成功了</p>
<p>这里默认使用的是 Cloudflare 官方的 DoH</p>
<p>如果不行的话，可以换成国内的 DoH 服务</p>
<p>比如阿里：</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://223.5.5.5/dns-query" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://223.5.5.5/dns-query</a></li>
<li><a href="https://223.6.6.6/dns-query" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://223.6.6.6/dns-query</a></li>
</ul>
<p>比如腾讯：</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://doh.pub/dns-query" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://doh.pub/dns-query</a></li>
<li><a href="https://dns.pub/dns-query" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://dns.pub/dns-query</a></li>
</ul>
<p>示例</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo cloudflared proxy-dns --address 127.0.0.1 --port 5053 \
  --upstream https://223.5.5.5/dns-query \
  --upstream https://223.6.6.6/dns-query
</code></pre>
<p>用 dig 或者 nslookup 之类的工具测试没问题的话，可以进入下一步。</p>
<h2 id="添加服务">添加服务</h2>
<p>创建 systemd service，让 cloudflared 常驻运行</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo nano /etc/systemd/system/cloudflared-dns.service
</code></pre>
<p>内容：</p>
<pre><code class="language-ini">[Unit]
Description=Cloudflared DNS over HTTPS proxy
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/cloudflared proxy-dns --address 127.0.0.1 --port 5053 \
  --upstream https://223.5.5.5/dns-query \
  --upstream https://223.6.6.6/dns-query \
  --upstream https://doh.pub/dns-query \
  --upstream https://dns.pub/dns-query
Restart=always
User=nobody
AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
</code></pre>
<p>应用 &amp; 启动</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo systemctl daemon-reexec
sudo systemctl enable --now cloudflared-dns
</code></pre>
<h2 id="配置dns">配置DNS</h2>
<p>使用 drop-in 配置的方式来设置 DNS</p>
<p>不要直接改 <code>/etc/systemd/resolved.conf</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo mkdir -p /etc/systemd/resolved.conf.d
sudo nano /etc/systemd/resolved.conf.d/dns.conf
</code></pre>
<p>内容：</p>
<pre><code class="language-ini">[Resolve]
DNS=127.0.0.1:5053
FallbackDNS=223.5.5.5 223.6.6.6
DNSSEC=no
</code></pre>
<p>重启服务</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">sudo systemctl restart systemd-resolved
</code></pre>
<p>检查生效情况</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">resolvectl status
</code></pre>
<p>可以看到以下输出</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">$ resolvectl status
Global
           Protocols: -LLMNR -mDNS -DNSOverTLS DNSSEC=no/unsupported
    resolv.conf mode: stub
         DNS Servers: 127.0.0.1:5053
Fallback DNS Servers: 223.5.5.5 223.6.6.6
</code></pre>
<p>这时候就搞定了，docker容器也会默认使用系统的这个 DNS</p>
<p>此时再去 swag renew 证书，就成功了✌️</p>
<h2 id="一键脚本">一键脚本</h2>
<p>老规矩，我让大模型爷爷帮忙写了一个一键配置DoH的脚本</p>
<p>默认使用从官方 GitHub 仓库下载 deb 包安装的方式</p>
<p>可以直接执行</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://gist.github.com/Deali-Axy/8b2ad8e5a601f2c43f6e7debdfb0aa29/raw/3c57dbce7dc0e224ad4ad35606f15cbc34d4810e/install-doh.sh)"
</code></pre>
<h2 id="脚本源码">脚本源码</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e

echo "[1/6] 安装 cloudflared..."
if ! command -v cloudflared &gt;/dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1; then
  wget -q https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-linux-amd64.deb -O /tmp/cloudflared.deb
  sudo dpkg -i /tmp/cloudflared.deb || sudo apt-get install -f -y
  rm -f /tmp/cloudflared.deb
else
  echo "cloudflared 已安装，跳过。"
fi

CLOUDFLARED_BIN=$(command -v cloudflared)
echo "cloudflared 路径: $CLOUDFLARED_BIN"

echo "[2/6] 创建 systemd service..."
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/cloudflared-dns.service &gt;/dev/null &lt;&lt;EOF
[Unit]
Description=Cloudflared DNS over HTTPS proxy
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=${CLOUDFLARED_BIN} proxy-dns --address 127.0.0.1 --port 5053 \
  --upstream https://223.5.5.5/dns-query \
  --upstream https://223.6.6.6/dns-query \
  --upstream https://doh.pub/dns-query \
  --upstream https://dns.pub/dns-query
Restart=always
User=nobody
AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

echo "[3/6] 重新加载 systemd 并启用服务..."
sudo systemctl daemon-reexec
sudo systemctl enable --now cloudflared-dns

echo "[4/6] 配置 systemd-resolved..."
sudo mkdir -p /etc/systemd/resolved.conf.d
sudo tee /etc/systemd/resolved.conf.d/dns.conf &gt;/dev/null &lt;&lt;EOF
[Resolve]
DNS=127.0.0.1:5053
FallbackDNS=223.5.5.5 223.6.6.6
DNSSEC=no
EOF

echo "[5/6] 重启 systemd-resolved..."
sudo systemctl restart systemd-resolved

echo "[6/6] 检查 DNS 配置..."
resolvectl status | grep "DNS Servers"

echo "✅ 安装完成！现在系统 DNS 已经走 DoH。"
</code></pre>
<p>将以上代码保存为 <code>install-doh.sh</code></p>
<p>运行</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">chmod +x install-doh.sh
./install-doh.sh
</code></pre>
<p>脚本会自动：</p>
<ol>
<li>下载并安装 <code>cloudflared</code></li>
<li>写入 <code>systemd</code> 服务文件并启动</li>
<li>配置 <code>systemd-resolved</code></li>
<li>自动重启相关服务并检查生效</li>
</ol>

</div>
